entities.name: Enriqueta Compte y Riqué
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Enriqueta Compte y Riqué was a Spanish-born Uruguayan teacher. She was the founder of the first kindergarten in South America in 1892, and famous for having contributed decisively to preschool teaching in Uruguay and Latin America.
